title: Under Lock & Key
description: A Minecraft datapack that allows for per-player locked chests,
body:
Want to lock your chest to prevent your friends from snooping through them? Now you can use my Under Lock & Key datapack! Craft a chest key using 1 chest and 8 gold. Shift right clicking while holding the chest key and looking at a nearby chest will lock the chest so only the person with the correct key can unlock it. Each key has the owner's name in the item lore so you can see who this key belongs to! 

Important info: 
-You MUST be crouching and looking at a chest within 5 blocks with an unobstructed view.
-The key uses the Trial Key item model, but is actually a wooden pickaxe, preventing actual trials keys from being crafted. My chest key does not act like a wooden pickaxe either.
-Due to my knowledge limitations, I am not able to do more than 1 key per player, meaning 1 key can open any chest that the player locked.
